title: Cartridge Filter

introduction.definition: A cartridge filter removes fine particles from a liquid or gas. Several pleated filter cartridges stand on a tube sheet inside a pressure housing. The fluid flows from outside to inside through the filter media; particles are trapped on the media surface, and the clean fluid flows down the cartridge cores to the outlet.
applications: Polishing of chemicals, water and solvents
key_points: Rated by micron size (nominal or absolute)
ΔP rises as dirt loads the media
Seals prevent bypass of dirty fluid
introduction.summary: A cartridge filter removes fine particles from liquids or gases. The fluid flows from outside to inside through pleated filter cartridges mounted on a tube sheet; particles are trapped on the media and clean fluid flows down the cores to the outlet. Cartridges are replaced when the differential pressure reaches its limit.

pressure.title: Differential pressure across the cartridges
pressure.description: Upstream (dirty side, red) pressure is higher than downstream (clean side, green). As dirt builds on the media the differential pressure (ΔP) rises; cartridges are changed at the maker's terminal ΔP (often ~ 1–2.5 bar) or a set interval. Too high a ΔP can collapse or bypass a cartridge.

video_tutorials.title: Cartridge Filter — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Cartridge Filter.
A cartridge filter removes fine particles from a liquid or gas.
Several pleated filter cartridges stand on a tube sheet inside a pressure housing.
The fluid flows from outside to inside through the filter media; particles are trapped on the media surface, and the clean fluid flows down the cartridge cores to the outlet.
Typical applications include pre-filtration before RO/NF membranes (≈ 5 µm); polishing of chemicals, water and solvents; fuel and lube-oil filtration; pharmaceutical and food liquids.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Housing (pressure vessel) & Body Flange, Bolted (or swing-bolt) Cover with Vent.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

script.narration: How the Cartridge Filter works.
Dirty fluid enters the housing.
It flows through the pleated media from outside to inside.
Particles are trapped on the media surface.
The tube sheet keeps dirty and clean sides apart.
Filtered fluid leaves through the bottom outlet.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.
Upstream (dirty side, red) pressure is higher than downstream (clean side, green).

video_tutorials.title: Cartridge Filter — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Cartridge Filter.
Record ΔP.
Replace cartridges at terminal ΔP; inspect seals.
Inspect housing and cover seal.
Watch for rapid ΔP rise: short cartridge life. Common cause: high solids load, upstream upset.
Watch for bypass: particles downstream. Common cause: damaged o-rings, poor seating.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
